name: B10-0329/2026 (ECR) – Continued crackdown on civic space and fundamental freedoms in Burkina Faso
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued crackdown on civic space and fundamental freedoms in Burkina Faso
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Burkina Faso's military government for closing down over 100 associations and many political parties, and for holding back freedoms of speech, assembly and association. It condemns attacks by jihadist groups and abuses by government forces and allied militias against Fulani civilians. It also warns about Russia's growing influence in the country's security and politics. The Parliament asks the European Commission, the EU's diplomatic service and EU member states to watch the human rights situation closely, support independent civil society and humanitarian groups, and work with African partners on terrorism, governance and regional instability. This is an opinion and a request; it does not change any law.

- The text calls for monitoring and support, not new laws; nothing changes on the ground yet.
- It affects Burkina Faso's government, its citizens, civil society and EU diplomats.
- Next, the EU Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
